component.name: Insomnium
component.summary: 100% local, privacy-focused API client for REST, GraphQL, WebSockets, SSE and gRPC

description.p: Insomnium is a desktop API client for testing and debugging HTTP-based APIs. It works entirely offline — no account required, no cloud sync, no telemetry.

ul.li: Environment variables and template rendering for reusable requests
OAuth 2.0, API key, Bearer token, and other auth helpers
Request chaining and response variable extraction
Import and export of collections (Insomnia, Postman, HAR, curl)

description.p: Insomnium is a community fork of Kong/Insomnia, maintained from the last commit before mandatory cloud login was introduced. All data is stored locally.

ul.li: Security updates across all major dependencies (jsonpath-plus, dompurify, axios, react-router-dom)
Release pipeline rebuilt with GitHub Actions
